Black uses a true black background everywhere (better battery life on OLED screens), with a dark grey tint on cards for contrast.
Follow System uses the language of your phone when the app has it. English and Dutch are available.
Tints buttons, accents, and pill and popup backgrounds throughout the app, in both light and dark mode.
The account is removed from this app. Files on the server stay where they are.
Use an app password, not your normal password. Create one in Nextcloud under Settings, Security, Devices and sessions.
Off by default. Only turn this on for a server on your own network. With http, your password and files can be read by others on the same network.

Set a password for the zip
Fill in the details below to connect.

App Lock uses your phone\'s own lock screen (PIN, pattern, password or biometric), not a separate Nooklin Files password. It asks once each time the app starts. It can only be switched on when your phone has a screen lock.
Set a screen lock or biometric on your phone first. App Lock uses it.
When on, screenshots and screen recording are blocked while using this app, and the app is hidden in the list of recent apps.

Home shows your Favorites and your Locations: On My Phone, USB and SD drives while they are connected, Nextcloud when you have connected it, and Recently Deleted. Tap a folder to open it. The arrow at the top goes up one folder, Back returns to where you were.
The view button at the top of a folder switches between List, Details, Grid and Compact grid. The choice is kept for all folders.
Long press an item, or choose Select in the ... menu, then tap more items. Select all is in the same menu. The X or Back ends selecting.

With items selected, choose Copy or Cut, open the folder you want and choose Paste. Delete moves items to Recently Deleted, where they stay for 30 days. On USB and SD drives there is no trash, so delete is permanent.

Show second pane in the ... menu shows two folders at once, side by side in landscape and stacked in portrait. Copy to other pane and Move to other pane work between them. When Nextcloud is connected, the second pane can show your server too.
Select items and choose Compress to zip, or Compress to zip with password (AES 256). Select a zip file and choose Extract here. A zip with a password asks for it first. Only zip is supported.
Tap a text file to edit it, up to 1 MB of UTF-8 text. It has undo, redo and colors for common code languages, and warns about unsaved changes. Other files open in the app Android picks for them.
The search bar finds files by name. On Home it searches the whole phone, in a folder it searches that folder and the folders in it, on the Nextcloud screen it filters the open folder.
Open a folder and choose Add to Favorites in its ... menu. Favorites are never added automatically.

Go to Settings, Nextcloud and fill in the server address, your user ID and an app password. Create the app password in Nextcloud under Settings, Security, Devices and sessions. Uploads and downloads run in the background with a notification.
Everything Nooklin Files does happens on this device. There is no Nooklin account and no Nooklin server.

The app uses the internet only to talk to your own Nextcloud server, and only after you connect one in Settings. Without a connected server it sends nothing anywhere. If you allow http (not encrypted) for a server on your own network, others on that network can read your password and files.
No analytics, no crash reporting, no usage tracking, no telemetry of any kind, and no Google services.

The app uses All files access to show and change the files on your phone. It only touches files when you ask it to. Your Nextcloud app password is stored encrypted with a key from the Android Keystore.
Recently Deleted lives in the app\'s own folder on your phone, uninstalling the app permanently deletes what is in it. USB and SD drives have no trash, deleting there is permanent.

A file is sent to another app only when you choose Share or open it. The one notification this app shows, for a copy, move, upload or download that is running, is made on your device and involves no server. App Lock uses your phone\'s own lock screen, Nooklin Files never sees or stores your PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint.

Nooklin Files is provided free of charge and \"as is\", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including any warranty that it will work correctly, be free of bugs, or be fit for any particular purpose.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, the developers of this app accept no liability for any loss or damage arising from its use, including loss of files or other data, however that loss occurs.
A file manager changes real files. Copy, move, rename, overwrite, extract and delete act on your own data. Check what you selected before you confirm, and keep your own backups.
Recently Deleted keeps items for 30 days, or sooner when it holds more than 2 GB or 1000 items. Items you delete permanently, and items deleted from a USB or SD drive, cannot be restored by this app.
Files on your Nextcloud server are managed by that server. What happens after a delete there, such as the server trash, is decided by the server and not by this app.

By using this app, you accept these terms and agree that you are solely responsible for your own data, backups, and how you use this app. This text is a general disclaimer and has not been reviewed by a lawyer for any specific jurisdiction.

Inter is the default font and first in the list.
App Lock with your phone's lock screen.
Disable Screenshots.
Help & Support with a How to use page.
Change log, GitHub link, Privacy and Terms under About.
Folders can be shown as List, Details, Grid or Compact grid.
The font Inter can be chosen.
The Nextcloud logo on the Nextcloud rows.\nMore color: icon tiles and colored file icons.
A status card for Nextcloud that shows if the server answers.\nA clearer Disconnect button.

Undo and redo in the editor.
Nextcloud folders can be downloaded, uploads and downloads run in the background.
The second pane can show Nextcloud, with copy and move both ways.
Zip files with a password.
Select in the ... menu.\nSearch bar at the top of Home and of the Nextcloud screen.\nHelp texts under the Nextcloud fields.

Text editor with colors for code.
Zip only, rar was removed.
USB and SD drives.
Nextcloud over WebDAV.
Bottom bar with Home, Recents and Settings.\nSearch bar at the top of a folder.\nFavorites are only the folders you add.
The last item in a list no longer hides behind the bottom bar.\nHome with Favorites and Locations.
First version: browse, copy, move, rename, delete with a trash, zip, a second pane and sorting.
Saved servers show up under Locations on Home. The passwords are stored encrypted with a key from the Android Keystore.
Optional. Empty uses the server address.
Only the address. Example: 192.168.1.20 or nas.local
The name of the shared folder, without slashes. Example: public
Empty logs in as guest. For a domain write DOMAIN\\user.
FTP is not encrypted. Your password and files can be read by others on the same network. Use it only on your own network.
The server is removed from this app. Files on the server stay where they are.
The items are deleted on the server. There is no trash, this cannot be undone.
This share does not exist on the server.
Enter the server address, without slashes or spaces.
Enter the name of the share.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
A system app. Android does not let an app uninstall it, you can back up its APK.
A back-up copies the APK file to the Download/App backups folder. Data of the app is not included.

FTP and SMB servers: save several, browse, upload, download, rename and delete.\nApp Manager: list, back up the APK, uninstall apps you installed.\nStorage: space and details of the internal storage and drives.
This PDF is protected with a password. Open it in another app.
No text could be read from this file. Open it in another app.
The files are counted by their extension. Apps, their data and the system are what is left of the used space, Android does not let this app look inside them.

Media on Home lists all videos, images, music and documents on the phone. Group by month, folder, file type or first letter, sort by name, date or size, and use the list button to jump to a header. Images, videos, music, PDF, DOCX and EPUB open inside the app. In the video player tap for the controls, double tap left or right to go 10 seconds back or forward, slide up or down on the left side for brightness and on the right side for volume, and slide sideways to seek. The ... menu has Play in background, the other button is picture in picture. DOCX and EPUB are shown as plain text. Long press the app icon on the home screen for shortcuts.

Media: all videos, images, music and documents in one list, to group, sort and jump through.
Viewers and players in the app: images, video, music, PDF, DOCX and EPUB. Gestures, play in background and picture in picture.
Shortcuts on the app icon: Recent Files, App Manager, Nextcloud, FTP and SMB.
Storage: a bar and the size per kind of file.
Allow Usage access to see the total size of each app, with its data and cache.
No backups yet. Back up an app from its dialog in the App Manager, it is saved in Download, App backups.
Tap a backup to install it again. Only the app itself is in a backup, not its data.
Android asks you to confirm. An app that is already installed can only be replaced by the same app with the same or a newer version. The data of the app is not restored.
Android needs your permission before Nooklin Files can install apps. Switch on Allow from this source on the next screen, then tap the backup again.

The App Manager lists your apps with their size under the name. Switch on Usage access (the Allow button at the top) to see the total size with data and cache. Tap an app to back up its APK to Download, App backups, to uninstall it (apps you installed) or to open its app info. The button at the top right lists your backups, tap one to install it again. App data is never part of a backup.

App Manager: the size of each app under its name, with the total size when Usage access is on.
Backups: install a backup again from the App Manager.
Files can be chosen by other apps when they ask for a file or a folder.
The text editor no longer runs under the status bar.
Nooklin Files asks for the permissions below. Nothing leaves your device because of them.
Needed to show and change the folders on your phone, to find recent files and media, and to count what fills your storage.
Without it these sections cannot be used and show only a message. Nextcloud, FTP and SMB servers, the App Manager and the settings keep working.
Needed to show the progress of copying, moving and uploading, and the controls of music that plays in the background.
Without it copying and playing still work, but you see no progress and no music controls outside the app.
You can give or change a permission later in Settings, Permissions.
This section cannot be used because Nooklin Files has no access to all files.

Permissions: the first start explains what each permission is for and what happens without it. You can say no.\nSections that need All files access show only a message and a button to give permission. Nextcloud, servers, the App Manager and the settings keep working without it.\nSettings, Permissions shows what is allowed.

Cut and copy now keep working outside the folder view: the Cut/Copy bar stays visible on Home, in Nextcloud and in FTP or SMB folders.\nPaste puts phone files into the open Nextcloud or server folder. A cut removes them from the phone after the upload.
The checksum could not be calculated.

Properties of a file or folder (size, folder totals, modified date, access) with SHA-256 and MD5 checksums.
More menu: Duplicate, Copy path, Rename for several items at once (name 1, name 2 and so on).
Home shows the free space of the phone and every drive. Storage lists the biggest folders and files.
Thumbnails in the folder lists and grids. Recents, search results, Recently Deleted and Nextcloud follow the folder view you picked.
Folder menu: add a shortcut to the home screen.
Music that keeps playing shows a small player bar in the app.
Paste items copied from Nextcloud into an FTP or SMB folder.
When off, the icons on Home, in Settings and in Storage use the plain grey look.

No more Material purple: surfaces, switches, chips, checkboxes and outlines are neutral grey, and everything that is coloured follows the Contrast Color you chose (same as Nooklin Calendar).\nAppearance, Colors: Colorful display. When off, the icons on Home, in Settings and in Storage lose their coloured tile.\nText fields are soft filled fields instead of the stock outlined ones; the Test connection and Disconnect buttons use the tonal style.

Settings design matched to Nooklin Photos and Calendar: rows are 44 dp high (switches and radio buttons no longer make a row taller), the divider lines up with the text, group titles are grey, tiles are 30 dp, notes are 12 sp.
Theme, Language and Font are one row each with a choice dialog.
Tile colors use the six colors of the other Nooklin apps.
Text sizes follow the same tokens as Photos (12 sp for meta, 14 sp for text). Destructive text has a darker red on light backgrounds.
Hidden files start with a dot and are not shown by default.
Share sends a file to another app exactly as it is. It is off by default. When it is on, a Share button appears when only files are selected.

Eerste release. Alles uit de 0.0.x versies zit erin. Nextcloud, FTP en SMB, App Manager, Opslag, Media, ingebouwde viewers en spelers, teksteditor, prullenbak, zip en het Nooklin ontwerp zijn onderdeel van 1.0.0.

Settings screen laid out like Nooklin Photos: section headings (General, Connections, Privacy, About) with grouped rows, and no switches on the main screen.\nShow hidden files moved to Appearance, Share moved to Privacy.\nScreen titles use the same bold title size as Photos.
